**Overview:**  
Maju Jaya Management Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited professional services firm incorporated on 1 Nov 2023 in Pahang, Malaysia. It provides management consulting for small‑and‑medium enterprises (PKS). The company has a share capital of RM 100,000, five directors, and its largest shareholder controls 63.59% of the equity. Reported revenue for the most recent year is RM 10,153,873 with equity of RM 5,198,085; net profit, audit opinion and current ratio are not disclosed. No legal cases are recorded.
